notes: «قال و روى لي بعض أصحابنا يعني محمد بن عيسى» — the text names the unnamed «بعض أصحابنا» right after «يعني», so the link is محمد بن عيسى (rule 8)
«قال نسيت إسناده» marks a gap in Muhammad b. Isa's chain: unnamed at that point, never filled from memory (rule 8)
«إذا أكلته تقول» is the saying's speaker, the Imam, who is not named: not added (rule 6), so needs ruling; «2» report number removed
